import numpy as np, json
def f(I):
    I=np.array(I); O=[]
    for bi in range(6):
        row=[]
        for bj in range(6):
            blk=I[bi*3:(bi+1)*3, bj*3:(bj+1)*3]

            mx=max(cnt.values()); cand=[v for v,c in cnt.items() if c==mx]
            row.append(cand[0] if len(cand)==1 else 0)
        O.append(row)
    return O
